purpose: Migration provenance for the lifecycle-extraction PR. This is a NEW provenance record, separate from the supervisor-extraction provenance recorded in tests/test_extraction_provenance.py. It documents only the lifecycle-specific migration.

registry_interface_design_decision.decision: Introduce a typed LifecycleStateRegistry protocol with a default minimal generic registry. AutoDev ships the registry, the registry builder, and the default registry. Project-/provider-specific states register against this registry via the AED-side adapter (PR 1b in the validated roadmap).
registry_interface_design_decision.rationale: Originally aed_lifecycle had a hardcoded TERMINAL_LIFECYCLE_STATES set that contained 14 reviewer-coupled states (HOLD_CODEX_RESPONSE_PENDING, MERGE_READY_AWAITING_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION, CODEX_CLEAN_PASS, etc.). Migrating that set into AutoDev would force the generic core to inherit AED-specific reviewer semantics. Instead, AutoDev exposes a registry protocol with a small, platform-generic default vocabulary (COMPLETED, FAILED, AWAITING_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION, OPERATOR_REQUIRED, HEAD_CHANGED, CI_PENDING, CI_FAILED, RUNNING, NOT_RUN) and reserves the provider-specific vocabulary for the AED-side adapter.
